name: Vasily II of Moscow
role: Grand Prince of Moscow from 1425 to 1462
contribution: Grand Prince of Moscow from 1425 until his death in 1462.
legacy: The Muscovites began developing an identity of the grand prince as the sovereign and the ruler of all the Russian lands, and this person positioned himself as the defender of Orthodoxy.

checks.lead: Vasily II Vasilyevich (Russian: Василий II Васильевич; 10 March 1415 – 27 March 1462), nicknamed the Blind or the Dark (Russian: Тёмный), was Grand Prince of Moscow from 1425 until his death in 1462.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
